title: Ron Digs in the Mud
lines: Ron digs in the mud. He digs up a cup!
"Dip it in a tub," said Mom.
Ron dips the cup and rubs it.
Mud is in the tub, but a dot is on the cup.
Ron rubs at the dot, but the dot is not mud.
Ron rubs and rubs. The cup has ten dots!
Ron pops pens in the cup. It is his cup.
